name: Netherlands

changes.why: The KNVB gave the women's team equal pay with the men from July 2022 (not in the earlier evidence), and the earlier open question on betting sponsors is settled: Dutch law ended gambling sponsorship of sport on 1 July 2025, and the main partners are KPN (to 2030) and Nike.

missing_checked: no UEFA discrimination sanctions on the KNVB 2021-26 (not among the seven federations fined at Euro 2024)

fan violence: Euro 2024 semi-final in Dortmund, 26 arrests around England v Netherlands with clashes involving both sets of fans; isolated, no sanction; the June 2026 unrest in The Hague and Rotterdam was mostly after Morocco's win, not Oranje fans
KNVB condemned racist online abuse of players after the 2026 World Cup exit and passed it to the public prosecutor (consistent with the existing anti-racism credit)
governance: criticism of Xavi's appointment (Sneijder on licence rules, reports he was a 4th or 5th choice); a process dispute, not misconduct, so O stays 7
government: Free (Freedom House 97), no hard line
notes: Kevin's blind gut rating had the Netherlands at 7 and Denmark at 8 (quiz 13). With this change and the Denmark change below, Netherlands V (7.3) and Denmark V (7.5) end up close together.

name: Denmark

changes.why: Oddset (Danske Spil's sports-betting brand) has been an official sponsor of the men's and women's national teams since 2016, renewed in March 2026 to 2028, and is also title sponsor of the DBU Pokalen. That is a betting sponsor (-0.8; less than a full point because of the 2026 limits: no logo on kit or training wear, no national-team players in its marketing). Partly offset by the 2025 national-team agreement giving women the same base fees and bonus rates, part-funded by a cut to the men's insurance cover (+0.2).

missing_checked: no UEFA discrimination or violence sanctions 2021-26; only a Euro 2024 fine (about EUR 10,000) for a banner abusing UEFA, which the DBU passed on to the fans responsible (minor, not discrimination)
Futsal team fined EUR 1,500 for improper team conduct (UEFA CEDB, May 2026); trivial, not counted
DBU governance stable; Salling Group partnership 2024-29 (retail, neutral)
government: Free (Freedom House 97, RSF 4th), no hard line
notes: Denmark was Kevin's top blind gut nation (8). This change lowers it for a documented betting partner, which his rules count against Values (compare Sweden: Svenska Spel main sponsor, V 5.8). If Kevin sees a state-run betting monopoly with these limits as milder, -0.4 (V 7.9) is the lower bound. Consistency flag outside this batch: Norway's earlier research left 'Norsk Tipping as NFF sponsor' unverified (V 8.3); it should be checked the same way.

This is on top of the four titles and the 2025 Europa League semi-final (raw scores.py value 5.2 -> 5.5).
